description: The chart illustrates the number of tasks associated with different language-family groupings in the referenced study. The categories are shown on the vertical axis as labeled horizontal bars, ordered from top to bottom as IE-Slavic, IE-Romance, IE-Germanic, Uralic, IE-Baltic, IE-other, IE-Indic, Semitic, Turkic, and Basque. The horizontal axis is the value axis labeled “# tasks,” shown on a linear scale with tick marks at regular 10-unit intervals from 0 to 80. Each category is represented by a single solid-colored bar: IE-Slavic (light blue) extends to just under 80 (approximately 79), IE-Romance (dark blue) reaches just under 50 (about 47), IE-Germanic (light green) reaches the mid-40s (about 44), Uralic (green) reaches about 20, IE-Baltic (light pink) reaches about 17, IE-other (red) reaches about 15, IE-Indic (tan) reaches about 10, Semitic (orange) reaches about 8, Turkic (light purple) reaches about 4, and Basque (dark purple) reaches about 3. The bars appear sorted in descending order by task count from top to bottom, and there are no stacked/grouped segments, legends, or visual emphasis annotations beyond distinct bar colors.
